root_cause.text: The `pqm_update_queue_properties` function in the DRM AMDKFD subsystem fails to release the buffer object reservation (`vm->root.bo`) in the error handling path when ring buffer mapping validation fails, resulting in a resource leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the addition of `amdgpu_bo_unreserve(vm->root.bo);` immediately before `return -EFAULT;` within the error branch of `kfd_process_queue_manager.c`, directly addressing the missing cleanup described in the CVE description.
